en.title: Backend Developer
en.stack: Node.js, NestJS, Jest, AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, API Gateway, Microservices, REST APIs

items: Wrote unit and end-to-end tests with Jest.
Built serverless solutions with AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS and Step Functions.
Developed applications with Node.js and NestJS, and REST APIs to integrate services.
Worked on a microservices architecture, with API Gateway managing the requests between services.
Handled parallelism and concurrency to improve the performance of complex systems.
